cues: Its details are physical, not emotional: an admit card in a polythene bag, four steel milk cans, the rain coming sideways.
And it ends not on the walk, and not on the mark, but on the driver who made room for three boys and asked for nothing.
The last line turns a private memory into something a reader can use: I have been trying, ever since, to be somebody's milk truck.
